Players Committee card image of the 0 side of [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: 0 side: “Deploy Vader's Castle and [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor. For remainder of game, you may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials. Where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if with a 'Hatred' card). Inquisitors are destiny +2. While this side up, once per turn, may ▼ a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site. Flip this card if Vader is at a battleground site unless Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site.” 7 side: “While this side up, you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader armed with a lightsaber, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. Flip this card if Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site; once per game, may take Vader and your cards on him into hand from a site you control.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Hunt%20Down%20And%20Destroy%20The%20Jedi.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
